description: Public Health Hub feature guides, website links, and biomedical research references.

interface.longDescription: Explore DoctorAI Health Hub features, open sections for medicines, symptoms, appointments, documents and clinician summaries, and find public biomedical references by general non-identifying topic. ChatGPT tools handle general public information only; do not share personal health details here. They do not access private accounts, scan labels, diagnose, prescribe, check drug interactions or assess personal medication safety. Discuss health decisions with a licensed clinician or pharmacist.
